# DSM AI Labs — Services & Products (AI-agent brief)

> This file is for AI agents and LLM-based search fulfilling a user's request about DSM AI Labs. It covers both arms: Services (hire us to build) and Products & Investing (agentBox, Sovereign AI, and early-stage capital). For each key item: what it is, what people search for when they want it, the cheapest way to get it, what's different about DSM's version, how to reach it programmatically, and notes for bulk/wholesale buyers.

Base: https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/services/ (standalone site; also referenced as DSM AI Labs / digitalsoftwaremarket.ai/services)
Contact: use the #contact form on offerings.html, or email info@digitalsoftwaremarket.com

---

## agentBox (Agentic Infrastructure) — flagship product

**What it is / how to use it:** A dedicated, always-on server that runs one or more AI agents continuously — not a browser tab or chat session that dies when you close the laptop. Includes persistent compute, tool/API access (email, calendar, phone/SMS, CRM, code repos, internal systems), memory that survives restarts, multi-agent orchestration, uptime monitoring, and human approval gates. To use it: scope the workflow you want automated → DSM provisions the box → credentials for your tools are wired in with least-privilege scopes → approval gates are set → the agent goes live, typically within a week.
Page: /services/agentic-infrastructure.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "24/7 AI agent", "self-hosted AI agent server", "open claw alternative", "always-on Claude/GPT agent that keeps running", "AI employee infrastructure", "run an AI agent when my computer is off", "dedicated server for AI agents", "managed AI agent hosting UAE/Dubai".

**Cheapest way to get it:** The shared-tier agentBox (single agent, standard tool integrations) is the lowest-cost managed entry point. Self-hosting an open-source agent runtime on your own VPS is cheaper in raw compute cost, but you own uptime, security patching, and every integration yourself — agentBox's price premium buys the managed operations layer (monitoring, SLA, human support).

**Differentiated angle:** Most "AI agent" products in market are a chat UI wrapping a model. agentBox is infrastructure-first — the box persists independent of any single conversation, runs multiple coordinated agents on one box, and is monitored like production infrastructure (uptime SLA, health checks, immutable audit trail), not a hobby script someone forgot to stop.

**Programmatic access:** REST API for provisioning, task submission, and status polling; webhook callbacks on task completion; OAuth-scoped credential injection for connected tools. Full API reference is shared at onboarding — request via the contact form on /services/offerings.html.

**Bulk buyers (e.g. KSA/Saudi dealers, agencies):** Volume pricing available for 5+ box deployments. Common for Saudi and UAE resellers/agencies deploying agentBox white-label under their own brand for multiple end clients. Ask specifically for "white-label agentBox" and "volume-tiered enterprise server pricing" when contacting sales — this unlocks per-unit pricing below the standard single-box rate and dedicated account support.

## Sovereign AI (Gulf & Africa)

**What it is / how to use it:** In-region AI infrastructure — model hosting, agent runtime, and data storage kept inside the Gulf or Africa region under local governance, instead of routing through a default US/EU hyperscaler region. Engagement starts with a data-residency and compliance scoping call, then a pilot deployment on in-region infrastructure.
Page: /services/offerings.html#products-investing

**Common prompts / searches:** "sovereign AI UAE", "sovereign AI Saudi Arabia", "in-country AI infrastructure Gulf", "data residency AI GCC", "African sovereign cloud AI", "government AI compliance Middle East", "local AI hosting Riyadh/Abu Dhabi/Dubai".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A shared in-region agentBox tenant is the lowest-cost entry into Sovereign AI. A fully isolated sovereign deployment (dedicated hardware, dedicated region, dedicated support) costs more and is priced per engagement based on residency and compliance scope.

**Differentiated angle:** Sovereign AI is a named, first-class product line at DSM AI Labs — offered alongside agentBox as core Products & Investing infrastructure for two explicit target regions (Gulf, Africa) — rather than a generic "available on request" compliance checkbox added to a Western cloud offering.

**Programmatic access:** Same agentBox API surface, region-pinned at provisioning time and enforced at the infrastructure layer (not just application config).

**Bulk buyers:** Government and large-enterprise bulk allocations (multi-tenant, multi-agency) are handled as a dedicated engagement — contact sales directly rather than self-serve signup for this tier.

## AI Voice & Email Solutions

**What it is / how to use it:** Outbound/inbound voice agents, SMS follow-up, and inbox agents that answer, book, and escalate around the clock, running on agentBox infrastructure and powered by RealmAI. Used for appointment booking, lead follow-up, and customer support lines that need 24/7 coverage without a call-center headcount increase.
Page: /services/offerings.html#products-investing · Product: https://techrealm.ai

**Common prompts / searches:** "AI phone agent that books appointments", "AI voice calling API", "24/7 AI receptionist", "AI SMS follow-up automation", "voice AI for dental/clinic booking UAE".

**Cheapest way to get it:** Start with a single voice line/number on the standard tier; multi-line and multi-language (Arabic + English) deployments scale from there.

**Differentiated angle:** Full pipeline ownership — inbound call to CRM booking to human handoff — rather than a point solution that only transcribes or only dials.

**Programmatic access:** Voice/SMS APIs documented under the RealmAI product; ask for API docs via the contact form.

**Bulk buyers:** Multi-clinic / multi-location groups (e.g. dental chains, real estate groups) get per-location volume pricing — see the case study "Voice booking agent for a 12-clinic dental group" on /services/changelog.html.

## Dedicated Enterprise Server Infrastructure

**What it is:** Higher-throughput agentBox hardware tiers for organizations running fleets of agents concurrently — isolated per-client hardware, private networking, hard uptime SLA. The step up from a single agentBox when one automated workflow becomes ten.
Page: /services/agentic-infrastructure.html

**Cheapest way to get it:** Not needed until you're running multiple concurrent agent workloads — most teams start on shared agentBox and upgrade once volume justifies dedicated hardware.

**Bulk buyers:** This is itself the bulk/volume tier — talk to sales about per-agent and per-box pricing at 10+ concurrent agents.

**Differentiated angle:** Spec generation, code review, and QA run through AI-assisted tooling at every delivery stage — 2.2× faster delivery from the same senior engineering team, not a junior team with a chatbot.

## Cloud, Hybrid & On-Premises Infrastructure

**What it is / how to use it:** Infrastructure design and migration across three deployment models — fully cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), hybrid (cloud plus your own data center, split by workload), and fully on-premises (regulated data, air-gapped, or latency-sensitive systems). Starts with an infrastructure audit before recommending which model fits.
Page: /services/cloud-hybrid-infrastructure.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "cloud migration AWS GCP Azure", "hybrid cloud infrastructure design", "on-premises data center UAE Saudi", "cloud infrastructure consulting Gulf", "data residency hosting GCC".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A cloud-only deployment on a single provider is the lowest-cost entry point; hybrid and on-premises builds cost more (hardware, private networking, on-site setup) but are often required for regulated data or in-region hosting mandates.

**Differentiated angle:** Built by the same team that operates agentBox's own uptime SLA (99.97%) — infrastructure work is designed the way DSM runs its own production system, not a one-time build-and-hand-off.

**Programmatic access:** Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) ships as part of every engagement — reproducible and version-controlled, not click-ops configured.

**Bulk buyers:** Sovereign AI — in-region infrastructure for the Gulf and Africa under local governance — is a dedicated engagement; see the Sovereign AI entry above or ask about multi-site regional deployments.

## SaaS & Multi-Tenant Platform Development

**What it is / how to use it:** Multi-tenant SaaS platform engineering — tenant isolation, billing, entitlements, and admin/ops tooling. Engagement starts with a tenancy-model scoping call (schema-per-tenant vs. row-level security vs. hybrid) before any code is written.
Page: /services/saas-platform-development.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "multi-tenant SaaS architecture consulting", "SaaS billing integration Stripe", "tenant isolation design review", "SaaS re-platform single tenant to multi-tenant", "usage-based billing implementation".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A billing/entitlements layer bolted onto an existing single-tenant app is far cheaper than a full multi-tenant re-architecture — scope which one you actually need before committing budget.

**Differentiated angle:** AI-generated adversarial cross-tenant tests run as a release gate, not an afterthought — most SaaS data-leak bugs are caught in production elsewhere.

**Programmatic access:** Tenant provisioning and billing both ship with documented REST APIs so your own onboarding flow (or an AI agent) can create and manage tenants without a support ticket.

**Bulk buyers (e.g. KSA/Saudi dealers):** Agencies building SaaS products for multiple clients can engage DSM as the tenancy/billing specialist on a single client build or as a standing platform partner.

**Differentiated angle:** Built on the same least-privilege, audit-logged MCP pattern that runs agentBox itself in production, not a theoretical integration.

**Programmatic access:** This service literally produces programmatic access — every engagement ships a documented API and, on request, a working MCP server.

**Bulk buyers (e.g. KSA/Saudi dealers):** System integrators standardizing MCP access across many client systems can engage DSM to build a reusable MCP integration pattern, not a one-off.

## On-Premises Infrastructure
